title: fix(ui): draw a refused list or related-list read as no-access, not a retryable failure
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgDFH4S5pR1C8YvYCWWsZfXx)_

## 维护者速读
- 改了什么：列表读取被拒（403）时不再显示「重试」按钮；记录页相关列表读取被拒时改画一行中性的「无权访问」提示，不再是红框加「你无权执行此操作」。
- 为什么改：成员只是没有读权限，重试不可能变好；红色的动作拒绝句让只来查看记录的人以为自己做错了事。
- 风险与回滚：只动两个组件的拒绝态分支，5xx、网络失败、api-disabled 的画法不变；回滚即还原本 PR 两个源文件。
- 先看：`ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/RelatedList.tsx` 的 `RelatedListLoadFailed`；`ui/packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx` 的 `list-error-retry` 条件。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-list/src/__tests__/ListView.forbiddenNoRetry.test.tsx packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/RelatedList.readFailed-26415.test.tsx`，预期全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

Fixes #27841

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changes

- **List view (`plugin-list` `ListView`).** The load-error panel no longer draws the Retry button for the `forbidden` kind (a 403 / `PERMISSION_DENIED` read), joining `api-disabled`. A refusal is a grant only an administrator can give, so a retry re-reaches the same refusal. `network` (network failures and 5xx), `unauthorized` and `rejected` keep Retry.
- **Related list (`plugin-detail` `RelatedListLoadFailed`).** A `forbidden` read is drawn as a neutral line: `role="status"` instead of `alert`, `border-border bg-muted/40` and a muted icon instead of the destructive tint, no Retry, and always the list's existing no-access sentence (`list.loadErrorForbiddenTitle` / `list.loadErrorForbiddenMessage`). A producer's `userMessage` on a 403 is no longer shown there: the server marks the generic action refusal ("You do not have permission to perform this action. Contact your administrator if you need access.") on a refused read, which was the red sentence the card saw. Every other kind is drawn exactly as before.
- No new i18n key; no copy changed.

## Tests

- New `plugin-list/src/__tests__/ListView.forbiddenNoRetry.test.tsx`: a 403 draws the no-access panel with no Retry; controls: a 500 and a network failure still draw Retry.
- `plugin-detail/src/__tests__/RelatedList.readFailed-26415.test.tsx` gains a describe: a 403 carrying the action-refusal `userMessage` draws `role="status"`, no destructive class on the line or its icon, the no-access title and sentence, no "perform this action", no Retry; controls: a 5xx keeps `role="alert"`, the destructive styling and Retry; a readable related list draws its rows.
- `ListView.errorStateComponent-7143.test.tsx`: the "retry button is still rendered" arm now fails with a 500 instead of a 403, since a 403 no longer offers one.

## Acceptance notes

- **Repro on main = the ablation.** Both source files restored to the base `38651598` (tests unchanged): the two new refusal tests fail (ListView: Retry button present; RelatedList: `role="alert"` received where `status` expected), and their 14 sibling tests, the controls included, pass. Restored by `git checkout HEAD`, `git diff HEAD` empty, blob hashes equal HEAD. The red action sentence on main is read from the code (`declaredUserMessage` wins over the fixed copy) and is asserted absent by the new test on the fixed tree; it was not measured on a live stack.
- `unauthorized` (401, "Sign in required") still offers Retry in both places. The card names 403 only; left as is.
- The ListView forbidden panel still uses its `text-destructive/60` icon; the card asks only that it drop Retry.
- Seat 4's draft PR #27793 regions (`RelatedList.tsx` docblock near the API-door note, `RecordDetailView.tsx` `apiHandler`) are not touched; this diff edits only `RelatedListLoadFailed` and its docblock.
